The Separatists offered me a deal&mdash;credits, protection. I could see my family again. I took it.|Griebs Kishpaugh, to Banks|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within" />}}
'''Griebs Kishpaugh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and later joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Kishpaugh joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as a way to support his family. He expected to remain in the local reserves, but he was instead sent offworld, away from his loved ones. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Kishpaugh switched his allegiances to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who offered him [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], protection from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] retribution, and a return to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Before Kishpaugh could escape in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with the aid of his [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] [[Z-37]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] confronted and stopped him. Kishpaugh was brought into Republic custody.<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within" />
